answer: Anchor each identity at one vertex, locking 120 POA for four epochs. Each epoch it must finish three tasks in three different skill families, each graded by a different cluster, with no repeat. Earnings unlock only after three diverse epochs; one repeat resets the streak. A willow branches many ways at once; a one-skill farm fails diversity every epoch. Ten fakes need thirty diverse tasks and thirty cluster slots per epoch, but each cluster caps reviews at two, so capacity runs out and cost climbs per fake. The chain verifies tags, cluster IDs, streak, and lock over the four-epoch horizon.
